'''Laakteen''' was an astronomical object in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region, located just off the [[Giju Run/Legends|Giju Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. It was the home of [[Laakteen Depot]], a one-time [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] base and later [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] outpost during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Laakteen Depot was [[Destruction of Laakteen Depot|destroyed]] by the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] during its maiden voyage.
